en: But the fun thing is I like impactful work.
zh: 但有趣的是,我喜欢有影响力的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And somehow I feel like I always wiggle my way through and then get to impactful work.
zh: 不知怎么的,我感觉自己总能想办法绕过去,然后去做有影响力的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what you say really hits home with me for other people that I've seen where they're super busy, but then the work that they might be doing might not be as impactful as they want it to be.
zh: 但你说的这些让我深有感触,是针对我见过的其他人,他们超级忙,但他们做的工作可能没有他们期望的那么有影响力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they either have the awareness or they don't have the awareness.
zh: 而他们要么有这种意识,要么没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: And typically when they have the awareness, they're like, yeah, but the impactful work is finite and it doesn't just go to me because I'm part of a team.
zh: 通常当他们有这种意识时,他们会说,是啊,但有影响力的工作是有限的,而且它不会只落到我头上,因为我是团队的一员。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it kind of goes to everyone or some people jump on it and then I don't want to step on their toes.
zh: 所以它可能会分给所有人,或者有些人抢着上了,然后我不想碍他们的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like there's a lot of reasoning there.
zh: 比如这里面有很多理由。

speaker: Unknown
en: But in the end, if everyone wants to do impactful work, I think that's really good for an organization.
zh: 但最终,如果每个人都想做有影响力的工作,我认为这对一个组织来说是非常好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yet people are working on busy work.
zh: 然而人们却在做琐事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sometimes that is not as effective or impactful.
zh: 有时那并没有那么有效或有影响力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes, there is always the business as usual, as we call it, the BAU.
zh: 是的,总有我们所说的日常业务,即 BAU。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you will always have those tasks in any profession you have, but you will always work on some projects.
zh: 但无论你在哪个职业,你总会有那些任务,但你总会去做一些项目。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the same time, either you're an engineer or you're an account manager or you're a recruiter or you're a marketing manager.
zh: 同时,无论你是工程师、客户经理、招聘人员还是市场经理。

speaker: Unknown
en: You should have your business as usual, but at the same time, you should work on more
zh: 你应该有你的日常业务,但与此同时,你应该做更多

speaker: Unknown
en: Outside of the box, more experimentation, more R&D if you would like.
zh: 跳出框架的、更多实验性的、可以说是更多研发的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what's next for us as a company?
zh: 那么作为一家公司,我们的下一步是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is where we connect the impact because let's take that for granted that you love the company that you work at, you support them, you're a big fan of the product, you're a big fan of their mission and vision, and you see yourself as part of it.
zh: 这就是我们把影响力联系起来的地方,因为让我们把这个当作理所当然的前提:你热爱你工作的公司,你支持他们,你是他们产品的铁杆粉丝,你是他们使命和愿景的铁杆粉丝,你把自己看作其中的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you see yourself as part of it, and of course some companies, they assist you thinking like that by giving you shares of the company, like you are an actual shareholder, you also want to do more about the company.
zh: 如果你把自己看作其中的一部分,当然有些公司会通过给你公司股份来帮助你这么想,就像你是一个真正的股东,你也想为公司做更多的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's why I said before you need to come with ideas.
zh: 这就是为什么我之前说你需要带着想法来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And not only an idea, a plan.
zh: 而且不只是一个想法,是一个计划。

speaker: Unknown
en: And not only a plan, perhaps something that you have tested, a pilot, something that you have tried before or you want to implement it differently in a different project.
zh: 而且不只是一个计划,也许是你已经测试过的东西,一个试点,你以前尝试过的东西,或者你想在另一个项目中以不同方式实施的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's interesting because if someone were to came to me and negotiated with me or I feel like that's kind of negotiating and says, okay, I don't feel like the work that I'm doing is impactful.
zh: 这很有意思,因为如果有人来找我谈判——或者我觉得那有点像谈判——说,好吧,我觉得我做的工作没有影响力。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't have any impact for initiatives.
zh: 我在主动倡议方面没有任何影响力。 [[402→422]] 我通常做的都是日常业务,但这里有一个我做过的实验的想法,这些是可选方案,而这才是我真正想做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I typically have business as usual, but here is an idea of something that I've done an experiment with and these are the options and this is really what I want to do.
zh: 我通常按常规办事，但这里有一个我做过实验的想法，这些是可选方案，而这才是我真正想做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why not, from my perspective, have someone work on that?
zh: 从我的角度来看,为什么不让这个人去做那个呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because first of all, they took initiative.
zh: 因为首先,他们采取了主动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Second of all, they seem super excited about this thing.
zh: 其次,他们对这件事看起来超级兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: They want to grow and work on impactful thing and they feel like they have this thing.
zh: 他们想要成长并做有影响力的事情,而且他们觉得自己手里有这个东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So organizations, they should enable the growth of their employees.
zh: 所以组织应该助力员工的成长。

speaker: Unknown
en: They should offer, let's say, frameworks, processes, how you grow, but it's on you how you will grow.
zh: 他们应该提供,比如说,框架、流程、如何成长的方法,但如何成长取决于你自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have the ownership of your own career.
zh: 你对自己的职业生涯拥有所有权。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So don't outsource this to anyone else.
zh: 所以不要把这个外包给任何其他人。
